name: MIDAX402
description: MIDAX402 — Independent verification for x402 services: we probe an endpoint, judge it against the x402 spec and sign the verdict so its signature is verifiable without asking us. Also pay-per-query intelligence over a curated x402 corpus, payable on Base Mainnet, Algorand Mainnet and Solana Mainnet. Non-personalized analysis of x402 ecosystem data, not financial advice.
